title: At 22, He's Making $120K And Asks If He Should Buy A Duplex And Continue Living With His Parents. 'I Wanna Make My Money Work For Me'
text: A 22-year-old with a $120,000 annual salary turned to Reddit for advice on whether to buy a duplex while continuing to live rent-free with his parents. The poster has already maxed out his 401(k), saved $32,000 in cash, and built up $6,000 in an investment account. “I wanna make my money work for me and make more money,” he wrote on r/personalfinance recently.
